tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the YappyKids shop (children's furniture, mattresses, bedding) with URLs. Call this first to pick a category id for search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products by keywords and/or category. Returns name, price (VAT included), availability, URL and image. Use 1–3 keywords in the shop language (product names such as "YappyQu", sizes such as "120x60", or category words such as "matracis"). To browse a whole category pass category_id and no quer

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full product card by id: description, attributes (dimensions, material, age), colour variants with availability, all images, price, GTIN. Prices include VAT.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Stock state of a product: in_stock, low_stock, preorder (with expected date), backorder or out_of_stock, plus the delivery time estimate for in-stock items. No quantities are disclosed.

tools.name: get_delivery_options
tools.description: Delivery methods and prices for a destination country and an order. Pass the product ids (with quantities) to get the shipping weight and order total computed from current prices, or pass order_total and weight_kg directly.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Shop facts: company, languages and domains, currency, VAT, returns (14 days), warranty, delivery and payment information pages, contacts.
